description: CARLA vehicle.tesla.model3 (blue skin), measured from the simulator's own physics/bounding-box data. Not the real Tesla Model 3 spec sheet: CARLA's mesh/collision model runs a bit wider than the real car (its bounding box includes the mirrors) and its overhangs are a bit longer, so numbers below are what the simulator itself will show a sensor, not the manufacturer's numbers.
source: vector_dev/carla/scripts/capture_surround_sensors.py: rear_axle_from_wheels() + vehicle.bounding_box + vehicle.get_physics_control().wheels, sampled after settle_vehicle() so the suspension has settled onto the road.
